note: Resident A/B harness arms: one server per binary, the prompt prefix restored from a session snapshot before every arm, 512 greedy tokens per arm, arms interleaved base/candidate. Fixtures are slices of ds4.c (8,192 / 62,000 tokens; 0k = 128 tokens). committed_tps / gen_tps are the harness figures over the whole 512-token call, which includes an occasional ~1.3 s first-token stall (gen_first_ms); tps_calls_2n (DFlash arms) excludes the first server call of the arm and steady_tps / ms_per_token (serial arms) exclude the first token, and those are the figures the documentation quotes. identity compares the committed token stream and the per-call acceptance profile with the shape reference recorded on the pre-campaign build; PROFILE-DIFFERS with IDENTICAL tokens is the conservative controller's timing-sensitive cost meter (call 83/84 at 8k), not a numerics change. quiet is the pre-arm machine check (GPU util, WindowServer, busy daemons).
